bio.text: Chris Beck is the Democratic nominee for Oregon's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Cliff Bentz after winning the May 19 primary.
He is a former state lawmaker from Phoenix, Oregon, and served three terms in the Oregon House from 1997 to 2003, representing House District 12 in Lane County.

OPB reports he worked for more than a decade for rural land use and conservation nonprofits before serving in the Oregon House, and spent six years as a policy adviser on rural economic development at the U.S. Department of Agriculture after leaving the Legislature.

sources.title: Former Democratic Oregon lawmaker will face Bentz in sprawling 2nd Congressional District
